'''''Fresh Kill''''' was a butcher's shop located in [[Gadrin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was run by the three [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] brothers [[Gordok]], [[Klallor]] and [[Vressag]]. The main product they sold was three-day-old [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] meat.
